topic: Fundamentals of Vectors: The Language of Space
target_audience: High school students or introductory undergraduate students

sections.title: What is a Vector? (The Arrow Analogy)
lecture_lines: Vectors show both magnitude and direction.
Scalars only describe simple numerical magnitude.
An arrow represents displacement in space.
animations: Draw an arrow vector in white color on the background alongside the compass icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg].
Label the vector as 'v' in light blue (#00FFFF).
Highlight the tip of the vector by flashing yellow (#FFFF00) near the map icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/map.svg].

sections.title: Coordinate Representation (The Grid System)
lecture_lines: Vectors live on a Cartesian grid.
Arrows start at the origin point.
animations: Draw a coordinate grid in light grey (#D3D3D3).
Place vector 'v' from origin to (2,3) in green (#00FF00) [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
Draw dashed lines to (2,0) and (0,3) in orange (#FFA500).

sections.title: Vector Addition (The Tip-to-Tail Rule)
lecture_lines: Connect the tail to the tip.
The result is the final path.
animations: Display two vectors 'v' and 'w' in white (#FFFFFF) using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg] to ensure accuracy.
Move 'w' so its tail meets the tip of 'v'.
Draw the resultant vector 'v+w' in red (#FF0000) using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pencil.svg].

sections.title: Scaling Vectors (Multiplication)
animations: Display a vector 'v' in white (#FFFFFF) alongside the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg].
Scale 'v' by factor 2, showing it grow longer.
Scale 'v' by factor -1, showing it reverse direction using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/spring.svg] to demonstrate the tension of the reversal.

sections.title: Synthesis & Summary
animations: Display all vector concepts together in a summary layout.
Highlight vector addition with a gold glow (#FFD700).
Fade everything out to black (#000000) for conclusion.
